subareas.title: Subareas
subareas.description: Craigslist New York subareas: mnh (Manhattan), brk (Brooklyn), que (Queens), brx (Bronx), stn (Staten Island). Empty = all of newyork.craigslist.org.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Minimum monthly rent in USD. Craigslist is full of $1 placeholder ads, so a floor helps.

query.title: Keyword query
query.description: Optional free-text search, e.g. 'no fee' or 'laundry'.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum rows to push in total, newest first.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch detail pages for new listings
fetchDetails.description: Open each new listing's page to fill beds/baths/lat/lon/photos/availability and scam flags. Results are cached in a named key-value store so a listing's page is only fetched once.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy groups. Empty = datacenter (cheap). Use RESIDENTIAL if Craigslist blocks datacenter IPs.

useHtml.title: Use search HTML instead of the JSON API
useHtml.description: Fallback/testing: read the server-rendered search page instead of sapi.craigslist.org. Used automatically if the API fails. HTML rows have no listedAt until the detail page is fetched.

debugUrls.title: Debug URLs
debugUrls.description: Maintenance only: fetch these URLs through the proxy and save the raw responses to the key-value store, then stop.
